long_biography.plain_text:
DeBiase's first major operating platform was medical-device distribution. Mark DeBiase Incorporated, trading as Joint Venture, sold orthopedic implants to surgeons and represented DePuy products across Florida. He served as Joint Venture's president, directing a sales organization that was active by the 1990s and later reassigned several South Florida territories to DePuy.

Food service became his next substantial chapter. DeBiase and Andrew Maider assembled a regional Jersey Mike's portfolio spanning more than two dozen locations from Jacksonville to Cocoa Beach, using separately registered operating companies for individual restaurants. In 2026, he opened Bang'N Bagel Company with Maider and sons Augie and Markie, applying the group's franchise experience to a new breakfast concept.
